Name: CraftableSprinklerAttachments
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Scroll down for the English version of the mod introduction[/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff0000][size=6][i]模组介绍[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=5]加两条洒水器升级部件的合成配方，并新增一个可开关的功能：让同一个洒水器同时装上「加压喷头」和「施肥器」，射程加成与自动施肥同时生效。[/size][/b]

[b][size=5]一、配方[/size][/b]
[table][tr][th]成品[/th]
[th]材料[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]加压喷头 ×1[/td]
[td]金锭 ×1 + 铱锭 ×1 + 电池组 ×1 + 精炼石英 ×1[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]施肥器 ×1[/td]
[td]金锭 ×1 + 铱锭 ×1 + [b]石箱 ×1[/b] + 精炼石英 ×1[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]二、配方解锁方式（模组选项 → 配方解锁方式）[/heading]
[table][tr][th]选项[/th]
[th]说明[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]直接解锁[/td]
[td]进存档立刻学会两条配方[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]耕种 5 级解锁[/td]
[td]耕种达到 5 级时自动学会（升级瞬间生效）[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]耕种 10 级解锁[/td]
[td]耕种达到 10 级时自动学会[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]购买配方解锁（默认）[/b][/td]
[td]到「购买地点」花金币/齐钻买配方，买完才进制作菜单[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]说明：切到更严格的方式时，[b]由本模组自动给出、且你还没花钱买的配方会被收回[/b]（比如从「直接解锁」切到「购买配方解锁」，就要重新去买）； [b]花钱买到的配方任何时候都不会被收回[/b]。改完在模组菜单里点保存，立刻生效。
[heading]三、购买地点与价格（只在「购买配方解锁」时有效）[/heading]
[table][tr][th]购买地点[/th]
[th]游戏内商铺[/th]
[th]计价[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]杂货铺 / 超市[/td]
[td]皮埃尔的杂货铺 + Joja 超市（两条都会上架）[/td]
[td]金币[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]矮人商店（默认）[/b][/td]
[td]矿井的矮人（需要矮人语翻译指南）[/td]
[td]金币[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]绿洲[/td]
[td]沙漠里桑迪的商店[/td]
[td]金币[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]齐先生的核桃房[/td]
[td]核桃房商店（需解锁核桃房）[/td]
[td][b]齐钻[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list]
[*][b]购买金币价格[/b]：默认
[code]10000[/code]，杂货铺 / 超市 / 矮人商店 / 绿洲通用。[/*]
[*][b]购买齐钻价格[/b]：默认
[code]25[/code]，只用于核桃房（核桃房本身是齐钻结算的商店）。[/*]
[*]两个价格都可以在模组菜单里直接改[/*]
[*]每份配方的价格独立计算；学会后商店条目自动下架，不会重复扣钱。[/*]
[/list][heading]四、双部件开关（模组选项 → 洒水器部件）[/heading]
[quote][b]允许加压喷头与施肥器同时装在同一个洒水器上[/b]（默认开启）[/quote][list]
[*]开启：已经装了其中一个部件的洒水器可以再装另一个；两个图标都显示在洒水器上，射程 +1 与自动施肥同时生效。[/*]
[*]关闭：恢复原版规则，一台洒水器只能装一个部件（已装好的加压喷头不会丢失，重新开启即恢复）。[/*]
[/list][heading]五、使用与拆卸[/heading]
[list]
[*]装部件：手持部件对着已放置的洒水器使用，和原版一样。[/*]
[*]施肥器里的肥料：右键洒水器打开肥料格（原版行为），装入肥料后播种即自动施肥。[/*]
[*]拆卸：用镐/斧敲一次，两个部件（连同肥料）一起弹回地面；再敲一次收走洒水器，不会丢东西。[/*]
[/list][b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6][font=Comic Sans MS]Module Introduction[/font][/size][/color][/i]
[color=#ea9999][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Adds craftable recipes for the two sprinkler upgrades in Stardew Valley 1.6, and an optional toggle that lets a single sprinkler hold both a Pressure Nozzle and an Enricher at once, with the range bonus and automatic fertilizing active together.[/font][/size][/color]

[size=5]1. Recipes[/size][/b]
[table][tr][th]Output[/th]
[th]Ingredients[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Pressure Nozzle ×1[/td]
[td]Gold Bar ×1 + Iridium Bar ×1 + Battery Pack ×1 + Refined Quartz ×1[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Enricher ×1[/td]
[td]Gold Bar ×1 + Iridium Bar ×1 + [b]Stone Chest ×1[/b] + Refined Quartz ×1[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][b][size=5]
2. Recipe unlock method (Mod Options → Recipe unlock method)[/size][/b]
[table][tr][th]Option[/th]
[th]Behaviour[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Unlocked immediately[/td]
[td]Both recipes are learned as soon as the save is loaded[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Unlocked at Farming 5[/td]
[td]Learned automatically when Farming reaches level 5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Unlocked at Farming 10[/td]
[td]Learned automatically when Farming reaches level 10[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Buy the recipe (default)[/b][/td]
[td]Buy each recipe from the chosen shop for gold or Qi gems[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=3]Switching to a stricter method [b]revokes recipes this mod granted for free[/b] (e.g. going from "immediately" to "buy", so you have to purchase them). [b]Recipes you actually bought are never revoked.[/b] Changes apply on save without reloading the save file.[/size]
[size=5][b]
3. Shop and prices (only used with "Buy the recipe")[/b][/size]
[table][tr][th]Shop option[/th]
[th]In-game shop[/th]
[th]Currency[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]General store / JojaMart[/td]
[td]Pierre's General Store + JojaMart (both stocked)[/td]
[td]Gold[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Dwarf's shop (default)[/b][/td]
[td]The Dwarf in the mines (needs Dwarvish Translation Guide)[/td]
[td]Gold[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Oasis[/td]
[td]Sandy's shop in the desert[/td]
[td]Gold[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Qi's walnut room[/td]
[td]Walnut room shop (walnut room must be unlocked)[/td]
[td][b]Qi gems[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list]
[*][b]Recipe gold price[/b]: default
[code]10000[/code], used by the general store, JojaMart, Dwarf and Oasis.[/*]
[*][b]Recipe Qi gem price[/b]: default
[code]25[/code], used only by Qi's walnut room (that shop is priced in Qi gems).[/*]
[*]Both prices are editable in the mod options menu.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]4. Dual attachment toggle (Mod Options → Sprinkler attachments)[/size][/b]
[quote][b]Allow Pressure Nozzle and Enricher on the same sprinkler[/b] (enabled by default)[/quote][list]
[*]Enabled: a sprinkler that already holds one attachment accepts the other one too; both icons are drawn, and the +1 range bonus and automatic fertilizing work together.[/*]
[*]Disabled: vanilla rules (one attachment per sprinkler). An already mounted nozzle is not destroyed; it works again as soon as you re-enable the toggle.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]
5. Using and removing attachments[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Attach: hold the item and use it on a placed sprinkler, exactly like vanilla.[/*]
[*]Fertilizer: right-click the sprinkler to open the Enricher's fertilizer slot (vanilla behaviour); planting in range then fertilizes automatically.[/*]
[*]Remove: one pickaxe/axe hit pops both attachments (and the fertilizer inside) onto the ground; a second hit picks up the sprinkler. Nothing is lost.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Author / 作者：ZengGod[/b][/*]
[*][b]Version / 版本：1.0.0[/b][/*]
[*][b]Requires /依赖：Stardew Valley 1.6+ ，SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Optional / 可选：Generic Mod Config Menu（游戏内「模组选项」菜单 / in-game mod options menu）[/b][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Craftable Sprinkler Attachments
Manifest.Description: Craftable Pressure Nozzle and Enricher, with configurable recipe unlocks (immediate / Farming 5 / Farming 10 / buy from a chosen shop), configurable gold and Qi gem prices, and an optional toggle that lets one sprinkler hold both attachments at once.
Manifest.Author: ZengGod
